newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Eight killed in Moscow casino blaze.
newsitem.headline: Eight killed in Moscow casino blaze.

text.p: Eight people died on Sunday in a blaze at a Moscow casino which the fire service said might have been started deliberately, Interfax news agency said.
The number of casinos has soared in Moscow since the collapse of communism. The mayor has said he wants to cut their number to five as part of a war against organised crime.
President Boris Yeltsin signed a decree on fighting crime in July and handed wide-ranging powers to security chief Alexander Lebed, currently engaged in making peace in breakaway Chechnya.
